create_Data2VecAudioConfig: create a Data2VecAudioConfig instance with default architecture settings for audio models
create_custom_config: create a Data2VecAudioConfig with custom conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel for feature extraction layers
validate_architecture: validate that conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel have matching lengths in Data2VecAudioConfig
compute_inputs_to_logits_ratio: compute the inputs_to_logits_ratio property from the product of conv_stride values
configure_masking_params: configure mask_time_prob, mask_time_length, mask_feature_prob, and mask_feature_length for self-supervised audio masking
